source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: DNS.sys.mjs documents that the native resolver API is not thread-safe and keeps one worker whose calls are queued. It registers an AsyncShutdown.webWorkersShutdown blocker that terminates the worker and clears its reference. DNS.worker.mjs opens the platform-specific resolver library, reports the candidate names and error cause when none loads, and dispatches lookup with the DNS object as receiver. Manual lifecycle proposal for this module: keep single-worker serialization, platform selection and shutdown ownership together when changing native lookups. Worker reuse does not prove a lookup cannot fail or that a mock test ran the native API.
title: Native DNS calls share a queued worker and explicit shutdown lifetime
